subject.title: ci(qa): reuse Matrix live workflow for releases

question: Should the release workflow reuse change land as stack 3 immediately after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103589, once its exact-head workflow and type checks are green?
rationale: The implementation appears technically sound, but release-gate ownership and stacked landing order require an explicit human inclusion decision because the base PR is still open and conflicted.

options.title: Land In Stack Order
options.body: Resolve and land the scenario migration first, rebase this PR onto that exact result, require green workflow/type gates, and then land it before the cleanup PR.

options.title: Collapse The Workflow Change
options.body: If maintaining the stack is too fragile, move this bounded workflow reuse into the dependency PR and close this intermediate branch after preserving its tests and documentation.

recommendation.title: Land In Stack Order
recommendation.body: Resolve and land the scenario migration first, rebase this PR onto that exact result, require green workflow/type gates, and then land it before the cleanup PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They own all three connected stack layers and have repeatedly refreshed this exact workflow head after review feedback.
